lede: Ohio State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +15.1 against +9.6, a 5.5-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Indiana −2.5 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Indiana winning 57% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is scheme fit, where Ohio State leads Indiana by 110 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 88% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
